info.title: Drydock API
info.description: Automation surface for Drydock. Authenticate with an organization API key (`Authorization: Bearer ddk_…`); see docs/api-keys.md. Every key reads; a key with `scan` access can also start reviews (operations marked `x-drydock-api-key-access: scan`). No key records a release decision. Package-diff endpoints are anonymous.

get.description: The key's name, display prefix, expiry, and organization. API keys only.

403.description: Not allowed for this credential or organization

post.description: Queues a review of one staged npm publish (`stageId`) or one published release. Needs a key with `scan` access; poll `GET /api/v1/scans/{id}/status` for the result. Starting a review never records a release decision.
